passive.name: Progenitor of All Demons
passive.desc: Demon Progenitor: Every hit also hits the whole enemy bench for 20% of its normal hit (no crits or bonuses). Each hit adds 3 Poison stacks (each stack: 0.8% of the enemy's max HP per turn, max 4 stacks, 3 turns). Heals 4.7% of its max HP every turn. Comes back once with 16% HP. Takes 2x damage from Sun cards.

passive.name: Limitless: Infinity
passive.desc: Nothing touches Infinity Sorcerer. Takes 36% less damage until it has been hit 4 times. 15% chance to dodge each hit. Every 2nd attack also hits the card behind for 35% of its normal hit (no crits or bonuses). Ignores the enemy's shields, dodges and barriers. With Curse Manipulator in your deck, both get +7.6% damage and HP.

passive.name: Malevolent Shrine
passive.desc: King of Curses's Dismantle and Cleave shred everything. Every hit also hits the whole enemy bench for 20% of its normal hit (no crits or bonuses). Each hit adds 2 Bleed stacks (each stack: 1.3% of the enemy's max HP per turn, max 4 stacks, 3 turns). Ignores the enemy's shields, dodges and barriers. Instantly kills enemies under 9% HP (not bosses).

passive.name: Wood Release: True Several Thousand Hands
passive.desc: Wood God Hokage: Every hit also hits the whole enemy bench for 20% of its normal hit (no crits or bonuses). Heals 4.8% of its max HP every turn. 18% chance per hit to Stun the enemy for 1 turn (it skips that turn). With Moon Eye Ghost in your deck, both get +15% damage and HP.

passive.name: Sukunahikona
passive.desc: Otsutsuki Vessel shrinks and expands anything. 34% chance per hit to Paralyze the enemy for 2 turns (50% chance to lose each turn). Each hit crushes the enemy: 8.5% of its max HP per turn for 2 turns. Takes 17% less damage. Heals 21% of the damage it deals.

passive.name: Baryon Mode
passive.desc: Six Paths Fox Sage burns his own life force into raw power. Hits set black flames on the enemy: 1.5% of its max HP every turn for the rest of the fight. +39% damage. Every other card in your deck gets +9.7% damage. Survives its first killing blow with 1 HP.

passive.name: Galaxy Impact
passive.desc: Fist Hero Vice Admiral: Ignores the enemy's shields, dodges and barriers. Every 3rd attack does 3x damage. Every hit also hits the whole enemy bench for 20% of its normal hit (no crits or bonuses). With Pirate King in your deck, both get +20% damage and HP.

passive.name: Soul Pocus
passive.desc: Soul Queen Emperor steals lifespans. Each hit also deals 10% of the enemy's max HP. Heals 30% of the damage it deals. Takes 25% less damage. Can't be stunned, frozen, paralyzed, confused, sealed or weakened.

passive.name: Gura Gura no Mi
passive.desc: Earthquake Emperor cracks the air. Every hit also hits the whole enemy bench for 20% of its normal hit (no crits or bonuses). Ignores the enemy's shields, dodges and barriers. Survives its first killing blow with 1 HP. Under 21% HP: +40% damage. When Fire Fist Brother falls: +34% damage.
